references.text: Isaiah prophesies about Jesus' sufferings, which include drinking the cup of suffering, reflecting Jesus' words about drinking the cup he himself must drink.
Jesus speaks again about the cup of suffering and the baptism he must undergo, paralleling what he says in Mark.
Jesus prays in Gethsemane and mentions the cup he must drink, which is a direct connection to his words in Mark about drinking the cup assigned to him.
Here Jesus expresses his anguish over the coming suffering, which can be seen as parallel to his statements about the cup of suffering and the baptism he must undergo.
